parameters.query: select f.id, f.canonical_url, f.title, f.summary, f.angle, f.relevance, f.specificity, f.angle_strength, f.score, f.tags, f.created_at, f.published_at, case when f.published_at is null then null else greatest(0, extract(day from now() - f.published_at)::int) end as age_days from feed_items f where (nullif($1,'') is null or coalesce(f.published_at, f.created_at) >= nullif($1,'')::timestamptz) and (nullif($2,'') is null or f.relevance >= nullif($2,'')::int) and (nullif($3,'') is null or lower(nullif($3,'')) = any(f.tags)) and (nullif($5,'') is null or f.score >= nullif($5,'')::int) order by (case when nullif($1,'') is null then f.score end) desc nulls last, (case when nullif($1,'') is null then f.relevance end) desc nulls last, coalesce(f.published_at, f.created_at) desc limit coalesce(nullif($4,'')::int, 20)
